heading: EXT. FERRY LANDING - MISSOURI RIVER - NOON

units.text: EXT. FERRY LANDING - MISSOURI RIVER - NOON
A flat-bottomed ferry tied to a splintered dock.
Mud, cottonwoods, a warped sign: CROSSING 5 CENTS.
Heat shimmers off the water.
ISAAC DELAROSA, fifties, ferryman, sits on a barrel whittling a peg.
TOBIAS "TOBY" WEATHERBY, twenties, a cattle driver, leans on a hitching post and fans himself with his hat.
Behind them, MRS. ETHELINDA PRIEST, sixty, in black bombazine, waits with a hatbox on her knee.
A silent drifter, HOLLOWAY STROUD, forties, sits on the edge of the dock with his boots hanging over the water.
Anyone else think this river's been getting wider?
units.name: TOBY

units.text: It's the same river.
units.name: ISAAC

units.text: I swear it's wider.
units.name: TOBY

units.text: Sir, when does the ferry depart?
units.name: MRS. PRIEST

units.text: When it's loaded.
units.name: ISAAC

units.text: It is loaded.
units.name: MRS. PRIEST

units.text: It has one passenger and a hatbox.
units.name: ISAAC

units.text: Then I shall speak with the other passengers.
units.name: MRS. PRIEST

units.text: She turns to Toby and Holloway.
Toby grins, puts on his hat.
Holloway doesn't look up.
Won't be long now.
units.name: HOLLOWAY

units.text: Isaac sets down his knife.
Toby's grin fades.
Mrs. Priest tilts her head.
Did you say something, sir?
units.name: MRS. PRIEST

units.text: Talking to the river, ma'am.
units.name: HOLLOWAY

units.text: The sound of hooves comes from the bluff.
Three riders appear on the ridge, silhouetted against the sun.
Toby straightens.
Isaac stands.
Holloway rises slowly, brushing off his knees.
Folks, I believe we have company.
units.name: TOBY

units.text: Mrs. Priest, get behind the barrel.
units.name: ISAAC

units.text: I will do nothing of the sort.
units.name: MRS. PRIEST

units.text: Ma'am.
units.name: HOLLOWAY

units.text: She looks at him.
He opens his coat.
Under it, a deputy's badge.
That'll be Ned Cutler and his boys. I've been waiting on them since Tuesday.
units.name: HOLLOWAY

units.text: Isaac and Toby stare at him.
Mrs. Priest sets the hatbox on the dock, opens it, and lifts out a short-barreled revolver.
I, too, have been waiting.
units.name: MRS. PRIEST

units.text: The riders start down the bluff.
Toby dives behind the post, Isaac drops behind the barrel, Holloway draws his pistol, and Mrs. Priest, with perfect composure, cocks the hammer and steps onto the open dock.
